errors.name: bad_indent
errors.message: indentation does not match any block
errors.at: the first character of the line
errors.doc: The first line of a statement must be indented exactly at the depth of the current block: 0 at the top level, and the depth of the `for` line + 4 in its body. A line after a blank line cannot continue the previous statement.

errors.name: tab
errors.message: tab character outside a string or a comment
errors.doc: Indentation and the space between tokens use spaces only.

errors.name: invalid_character
errors.message: invalid character {char}
errors.doc: The character cannot start any token. A CR that is not followed by LF is also invalid.

errors.name: invalid_utf8
errors.message: the file is not valid UTF-8
errors.doc: Source files are UTF-8. A byte order mark at the start is allowed.

errors.name: invalid_number
errors.message: invalid number '{text}'
errors.at: the first character of the number
errors.doc: Write `0.5`, not `.5`, and `1.0`, not `1.`. A number cannot be directly followed by a letter, unless the letters are an exponent or a length unit (`mm`, `cm`, `in`, `pt`). A number that is too large for binary64 is invalid; write `inf`.

errors.name: invalid_color
errors.message: invalid color '{text}'; write #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa
errors.doc: A color is `#` followed by 6 or 8 hexadecimal digits.

errors.name: unterminated_string
errors.message: the string is not closed before the end of the line
errors.doc: Strings cannot span lines. Join long strings with `+`. A `"` inside a string is written as `""`.

errors.name: name_too_long
errors.message: the name is longer than 255 characters
errors.at: the first character of the name
errors.doc: Names have at most 255 characters.

errors.name: unmatched_end
errors.message: `end` without a matching `for`
errors.doc: `end` closes the `for` at the same depth.

errors.name: missing_end
errors.message: `for` without a matching `end`
errors.doc: Each `for` needs an `end` at the same depth.

errors.name: unexpected_token
errors.message: expected {expected}, found {found}
errors.at: the first token that does not fit the grammar, or just after the last character of a statement that ends too early
errors.doc: The statement does not match the grammar.

errors.name: invalid_assignment_target
errors.message: cannot assign to this; the left side must be a name, optionally with an index
errors.at: the first character of the left side
errors.doc: The left side of an assignment has the form `ref [ index ]`.

errors.name: assign_to_coordinate_point
errors.message: cannot assign to a single coordinate index such as w[x=1.5]
errors.at: the first character of the left side
errors.doc: A single-coordinate index reads an interpolated value. It cannot be the target of an assignment. A coordinate range such as `w[x=1.0..2.0]` can be.

errors.name: mixed_and_or
errors.message: `and` and `or` cannot be mixed without parentheses
errors.at: the first and or or that mixes with the other
errors.doc: Write `(a and b) or c`, or `a and (b or c)`.

errors.name: chained_comparison
errors.message: comparisons cannot be chained; join them with `and`
errors.doc: Write `a < b and b < c`, not `a < b < c`.

errors.name: if_operand
errors.message: `if` must be in parentheses when it is an operand
errors.doc: Write `1 + (if a then b else c)`.

errors.name: argument_after_option
errors.message: positional arguments must come before options
errors.doc: In a command, all `key=value` options come after the positional arguments.

errors.name: positional_after_named
errors.message: positional arguments must come before named arguments
errors.doc: In a function call, named arguments such as `step=0.05` come after the positional ones.

errors.name: fn_outside_function_file
errors.message: `fn` can only be written in a .figf file
errors.doc: Functions are defined in function files (`.figf`), not on the command line or in command files (`.figc`).

errors.name: statement_in_function_file
errors.message: a .figf file can only contain `fn` definitions
errors.at: the first token of the statement
errors.doc: Function files hold `fn` definitions and comments only.

errors.name: for_range_needs_ends
errors.message: the range of a `for` needs both ends
errors.doc: Write `for i in 0..4 do`, not `for i in 0.. do`.

errors.name: text_after_do
errors.message: the body of a `for` starts on the line after `do`
errors.doc: The header of a `for` ends at the line whose last token is `do`.

errors.name: option_only_literal
errors.message: {kind} can only be an option value
errors.at: the first character of the literal
errors.doc: Lengths such as `60mm` and colors such as `#d62728` can be written only as option values.

errors.name: undefined_name
errors.message: undefined name '{name}'
errors.doc: The name is looked up in the current folder only. Write a path such as `root.a.b` for other folders. The message may suggest a similar name.

errors.name: kind_conflict
errors.message: '{name}' already exists as {kind}
errors.doc: The kind of a name never changes implicitly. For example, `let norm = 1` fails when an array `norm` exists.

errors.name: case_conflict
errors.message: '{name}' differs only in case from '{other}' in the same folder
errors.doc: Names are case-sensitive, but two names in the same folder cannot differ only in case.

errors.name: reserved_name
errors.message: '{name}' is a reserved word or a command name
errors.doc: Reserved words and command names cannot be names of arrays, variables, folders, or functions.

errors.name: loop_variable_conflict
errors.message: loop variable '{name}' clashes with {other}
errors.doc: A loop variable cannot use a name that exists in the current folder, or the name of an enclosing loop variable.

errors.name: assign_to_loop_variable
errors.message: cannot assign to loop variable '{name}'
errors.doc: Loop variables are read-only.

errors.name: assign_to_undefined
errors.message: '{name}' does not exist; define it with `array` or `let`
errors.doc: An assignment stores values in an existing array or variable. It does not create names.

errors.name: name_exists
errors.message: '{name}' already exists
errors.doc: A command that creates names fails if a name already exists. Add replace=true to replace it, if the command has that option. `array` and `let` replace without it. `source` can be run again with the same name.

errors.name: doc_unknown_name
errors.message: '{name}' is not an input or a parameter of '{function}'
errors.doc: A documentation comment `/// name: description` must name an input or a parameter of the function below it.

errors.name: doc_duplicate_name
errors.message: '{name}' is described twice
errors.doc: Each input or parameter can be described once.

errors.name: recursive_function
errors.message: '{function}' calls itself through {path}
errors.doc: Cycles in the call graph of functions are not allowed, so every statement finishes.

errors.name: function_refers_outside
errors.message: functions can refer only to their inputs and parameters, not to '{name}'
errors.doc: Functions are pure. They cannot refer to arrays or variables in folders.

errors.name: function_shadows_builtin
errors.message: '{name}' is a built-in function or fit model
errors.doc: A user function cannot have the name of a built-in function or a built-in fit model.

errors.name: duplicate_definition
errors.message: '{name}' is defined twice
errors.doc: A function, an input, or a parameter is defined twice.

errors.name: unknown_option
errors.message: unknown option '{option}' for '{command}'
errors.doc: The options of each command are listed in spec/commands.json and shown by `help`.

errors.name: repeated_option
errors.message: option '{option}' is given twice
errors.doc: Each option can be given once.

errors.name: wrong_argument_count
errors.message: '{command}' takes {expected} positional arguments, found {found}
errors.doc: The positional arguments of each command are listed in spec/commands.json.

errors.name: type_mismatch
errors.message: expected {expected}, found {found}
errors.doc: There is no implicit type conversion. Convert between numbers and strings with `str` and `num`.

errors.name: invalid_option_value
errors.message: invalid value for option '{option}': {reason}
errors.doc: The value is not one of the allowed words, or it is outside the allowed range. This also covers text with invalid figlab text notation (spec.md 8.4), and keys of init, fix, or bounds that are not parameters of the model.

errors.name: missing_option
errors.message: '{command}' needs the option '{option}'
errors.doc: The option is required.

errors.name: cd_in_loop
errors.message: `cd` cannot be used in the body of a `for`
errors.doc: Name resolution must not change in the middle of a loop.

errors.name: parent_folder_argument
errors.message: `..` can only be an argument of `cd`
errors.doc: `cd ..` moves to the parent folder. No other command takes `..`.

errors.name: index_count
errors.message: '{name}' has {dims} dimensions, but {count} indices were given
errors.doc: The number of indices must equal the number of dimensions of the array.

errors.name: wrong_function_arguments
errors.message: wrong arguments for '{function}': {reason}
errors.doc: The arguments of each built-in function are listed in spec/commands.json. User functions take their inputs and parameters, in order.

errors.name: not_a_model
errors.message: '{name}' cannot be a fit model; it needs exactly one input before `|`
errors.doc: A fit model is a built-in model or a user function with `|` and one input.

errors.name: index_out_of_range
errors.message: index {index} is out of range 0..{last}
errors.doc: Indices start at 0. A range that extends outside the array is an error.

errors.name: empty_coordinate_range
errors.message: no points have coordinates in {range}
errors.doc: A coordinate range must contain at least one point.

errors.name: shape_mismatch
errors.message: shapes {left} and {right} do not match
errors.doc: Operations between arrays need the same shape. Only scalars are applied to every element. Align other shapes explicitly, for example with `repeat`.

errors.name: coordinate_conflict
errors.message: the coordinates of {left} and {right} conflict; remove them with values()
errors.doc: Operations between arrays whose coordinates are set and differ are errors.

errors.name: integer_conversion
errors.message: cannot store {value} in an integer array; use round() or trunc()
errors.doc: Storing a non-integer value, NaN, or an out-of-range value in an integer array is an error.

errors.name: invalid_name
errors.message: '{text}' is not a valid name
errors.doc: A name computed from a string, such as as=nameof(d), must follow the rules for names: a letter followed by letters, digits, and _, and not a reserved word or a command name.

errors.name: cannot_access_file
errors.message: cannot read or write '{file}': {reason}
errors.doc: The file does not exist, cannot be opened or written, or is not in the expected format.

errors.name: number_conversion
errors.message: cannot convert '{text}' to a number
errors.doc: num() needs text that is a number, such as "1.5e3".

errors.name: folder_not_empty
errors.message: folder '{name}' is not empty; add recursive=true to remove it with everything in it
errors.doc: rm removes a folder that is not empty only with recursive=true.

errors.name: category_axis
errors.message: {operation} is not possible on a category axis
errors.doc: Log scale, fitting, and coordinate ranges are not possible on a category axis.
